title: Union of India v. Mohit Minerals Pvt. Ltd.

content.caseIdentity: Union of India v. Mohit Minerals Pvt. Ltd., (2022) 10 SCC 700
content.facts: The case concerned GST levy and the legal effect of a Council recommendation.
questionsBeforeCourt: What is the constitutional and statutory force of GST Council recommendations?
content.ratioDecidendi: GST Council recommendations have persuasive value within the constitutional design but are not automatically binding as primary legislation without statutory implementation.
content.holding: The Court interpreted the federal GST framework accordingly.
content.relevance: Use for GST levy, delegated action and constitutional federalism.
